title: spawn and awaiting a cold future still start the body at once
purpose: Run the program and observe the order of its output.

stdout.text:
main: before spawn
spawned: started
main: after spawn
main: cold created
cold: started
main: cold awaited 1

provenance.origin: authored for #340; Sparrow (Tomato) is the reference behaviour
provenance.expected_basis: #340 keeps eager start: spawn runs the task until its first suspension, await of a cold future runs its body before await continues.
